# BriTania

> English courses, language events, copywriting and translations by Tania Prestini (BriTania), based near Bergamo (Val Seriana), Italy.

BriTania offers personalised English lessons, informal practice events, business copywriting and Italian↔English translation. Contact: taniaprestini@gmail.com · +39 347 804 6948.

## Pages

- [Home (Italian)](https://bri-tania.com/): about, services, formats, contact
- [Home (English)](https://bri-tania.com/en/): English version of the same content
- [About summary](https://bri-tania.com/about.md): concise profile for agents
- [Full site dump](https://bri-tania.com/llms-full.txt): complete Markdown content (llms-full)

## Services

- English courses (all ages/levels; one-to-one or groups; TEFL-qualified)
- Informal English events and social practice formats
- English copywriting for companies and organisations
- Translations Italian ↔ English

## Formats

- English Tasting
- Travel & Songs
- English Breakfast
- TV & Book Club
- Back on Track (summer campus for students)
